             Dear Sir/Madam,

             Pursuant to Regulation 30(4) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015,
             and SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/CFD/CFD-PoD-1/P/CIR/2023/123 dated July 22, 2023, we are pleased to
             announce that DEVIT has been awarded a significant order from Gujarat International Finance Tec- City
             (GIFT) for the Procurement of AutoCAD License with 3 years of subscription in DTA area of GIFT City.

              Key Features: -
                 1. An integrated BIM platform that supports architectural design, structural engineering, MEP, and
                     construction workflows
                 2. 2D drafting and 3D modelling, and includes AI-based features like Smart Blocks, Markup Import, and
                     automation
                 3. Cost-effective drafting tool for zoning drawings, layouts, regulatory documents

             The total value of the order is approximately INR 29 Lakhs.

             The details of the order as per SEBI has been annexed herewith this letter.

             Kindly take the note of above information on record and oblige.

             Thanking you,
             Yours faithfully,
